question: In a certain code language, ‘COUNTY’ is written as ‘ULCYGN’ and 'FOREST' is written as 'RLFTHE'. How will ‘MARGIN’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'COUNTY’ is written as ‘ULCYGN',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22412578103228f2d72beaddda1bb43231de6c889ddacd4636551e10fa7f57cd.png] 

‘FOREST' is written as 'RLFTHE’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a8b5a39be265852d8154292d2d1f85feeb773300813fe611027800fac4daabf.png] 

Similarly, for '**MARGIN**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f489ef07b8f3e0bb3473d69e36a9690ded28cc7b9c0dfae5354168d2ee5fe1d.png] 

So, 'MARGIN' will be written as '**RZMNRG**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
